a.d: In Palmas, pharmacies are everywhere and the “farmacêutico” can recommend simple remedies. Say “Estou com dor de cabeça” or “Estou resfriado”. Prescription drugs need a “receita”. False friend: “constipado” does not mean constipated here; it is a Portuguese (Portugal) word for a cold.
